chart.programText:
A = data('tcp.bytes', filter=filter('az_equal', 'false'), rollup='rate').sum(by=['source.workload.name', 'dest.workload.name']).mean(over='1h').publish(label='A', enable=False)
C = (A).timeshift('1d').mean(over='1h').publish(label='C', enable=False)
E = ((A-C)/A*100).publish(label='E')
